blocks.content: This  section  details  recommended  procedures  for  problems  not  associated  with malfunction alarms. Before performing any troubleshooting procedure, turn the infuser off, then on.
Allow the self test to complete and proceed as follows:
If  a  malfunction  exists,  carefully  inspect  the  infuser  for  damage  as  described in Section 5.2.2.
If  an  infuser  inspection  has  not  disclosed  a  malfunction,  perform  the  PVT in Section 5.2. See Table 64 for section reference, probable cause, and corrective actions.
If, after completing step 1 and step 2, a malfunction has not been located, or if the infuser persistently fails, contact Hospira (see Section 6.1) .
